name: Acne vulgaris
general: Gentle non-comedogenic cleanser twice daily, oil-free moisturiser and sunscreen. Do not squeeze lesions. Topicals take 8–12 weeks to work.
special: Pregnancy: azelaic acid 20% or topical clindamycin + BPO; erythromycin/azithromycin if oral needed. No retinoids, no tetracyclines. Children under 8: no tetracyclines.

rx.instr: Always with benzoyl peroxide; avoid antibiotic alone

lines.when: Severe nodulocystic, scarring or failed oral antibiotic

rx.instr: After a fatty meal; pregnancy test, LFT, lipids at baseline; strict contraception

rx.drug: Women with hormonal features: Tab. Spironolactone 50 mg
rx.instr: Or combined OCP; check potassium if renal disease
